Messages.Author: TwoRazorReign
Messages.Body: In all seriousness, I would be interested to see what a deck using this many disciplines would look like. Maybe a stealth-bleed deck with lots of combat support and some intercept would be the way to go. Also, card-cycling enhacers would be a good idea to lessen hand jamming on stealth and combat cards.

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
If you make a deck around a star, then you can actually use the disciplines. Arika has six disciplines for example. Cell for gives you forced march. Aus cel gives you quicken sight. Aus pre gives you charismatic aura and some other stuff. Most of these cards won't make the cut because they don't help you win in a real game. Why add disciplines to that? If you decide to do arika with fos, then maybe serpentis for temptation. Potence? If instead of fos you use Nosferatu maybe. You would only try to use eight disciplines if you are a bad deck builder or completely reliant on a star vampire
